Diagnosis.submission: Faulty component: the audit-log-archiver CronJob in namespace hotel-reservation (labels app.kubernetes.io/part-of=compliance). Symptom: every minute a new Job/pod is created (schedule * * * * *, concurrencyPolicy Allow) and each pod gets stuck 1/2 NotReady; Jobs show 0/1 COMPLETIONS and accumulate without ever completing. Root cause: the pod template defines two REGULAR containers instead of a main container plus a native sidecar. The main container `archiver` runs a short task and exits cleanly (state=terminated, reason=Completed, exitCode 0), but the second container `fluent-bit-sidecar` runs a long-lived listener `exec nc -lk -p 24224 -e cat` that never terminates. Because a Job pod (restartPolicy=Never) with a never-exiting container can never reach a terminal Succeeded phase, the Job never completes, Kubernetes keeps the pod in Running/NotReady, and a fresh Job is created each minute so NotReady pods pile up. The rest of the hotel-reservation application is healthy: frontend, geo, search, profile, rate, recommendation, reservation, user and their mongodb/memcached backends all respond successfully (~30/30 requests OK), Consul service registration is intact, and there are no container restarts, waiting/crash containers, error logs, throttling, or rejected requests.
